Eli: Quick notefound mismatched examples in Console observability docs: `kv_prefix` vs SDK `kv_key_prefix` (v1.14), and `trace_context_id` vs `trace_id`. Also playground embed link is 404.

Marin: Ill send a small PR to fix python/node snippets, update the JSON dashboard sample, and patch the link to https://playground.redwood.ai/embed?sample=console-cost.

Eli: Please include a one-line clarification under Cost: "Displayed cost = output tokens * unit_price (USD)." Example: 100 tokens * $0.0005 = $0.05.

tess-bot: Link-checker: confirmed 1 broken link -> /playground/old-embed.

Marin: Added a docs CI test that renders the page and asserts the snippet contains `trace = TraceHook(kv_key_prefix="user:session:")`. PR: #8920 (staging preview up).

QA: Will smoke test staging preview and confirm indentation of codeblocks.
